MobileTagCLIPTextEncode.description: Encodes a prompt into conditioning with CLIP, plus "Tag mode" and "Re-roll every run" switches for the front-end random tag composer.

clip.tooltip: The CLIP model used for encoding the text.

标签模式.name: Tag mode
标签模式.tooltip: When on, the front-end composes random tags from the tag catalogue and injects them into the prompt; when off it behaves exactly like the built-in CLIP text encode.

每次随机.name: Re-roll every run
每次随机.tooltip: When on, tags are re-rolled for every queued run (each batch item too); when off the tags currently shown on the node are reused.
